input.encoding: [n] where n is the square matrix dimension

output.meaning: sum of the final y vector, accumulated in increasing row order after the PolyBench gesummv kernel

source_bound.description: The PolyBench/C gesummv kernel initializes alpha=1.5, beta=1.2, x[i]=(i mod n)/n, A[i][j]=((i*j+1) mod n)/n, and B[i][j]=((i*j+2) mod n)/n. For each row it accumulates tmp[i]=A[i][j]*x[j]+tmp[i] and y[i]=B[i][j]*x[j]+y[i], then assigns y[i]=alpha*tmp[i]+beta*y[i]. The scalar suite output is a source-order sum of that final y vector. The original dataset size is reduced to 1..64 for bounded suite calls.
